text:
Maya (docs): Quick flag — I found a misleading example in the EU data residency CLI section, it sets an env var that doesn't exist anymore.
Tom R (eng): oh no, which file/line?
Maya (docs): docs/regions/cli.md, the snippet uses REDWOOD_REGION=eu-central but our runtime expects REGION_ALIAS or --region now.
Jin (intl): that was from a legacy script, we deprecated REDWOOD_REGION months ago. Good catch.
Maya (docs): should we swap to the new CLI form and add a short note about alias mapping?
Priya (legal): please don't change language about 'data residency guarantees' — we should keep the legal phrasing intact, just fix the example call.
Tom R (eng): agree. Proposed change: replace env-var example with the explicit flag form and add a footnote about how alias -> region mapping works. Example: 
```bash
# correct: explicit flag (preferred for clarity)
rdwctl deploy --region eu-west-1 --residency-data-policy retained
```
Maya (docs): perfect. I'll also add a one-line parenthetical: "(If you previously used REDWOOD_REGION, use REGION_ALIAS or the --region flag; aliases are mapped in the runtime)".
Jin (intl): can we add a short table of common alias mappings? e.g., eu -> eu-west-1, eu-central -> eu-central-1? Helps readers migrating.
Maya (docs): yes, short 3-row table under "CLI examples". Keep it minimal.
Priya (legal): instead of 'data-policy retained' use the exact label we expose in the product: "residency=retained" — we need consistency between docs and product UI/CLI names.
Tom R (eng): good catch. Quick check: the CLI currently accepts `--residency retained` and `--residency ephemeral`. So example should be: 
```bash
rdwctl deploy --region eu-west-1 --residency retained
```
Maya (docs): noted. I'll update snippet and add a short note: "Using `--residency retained` opts into EU-only storage for model artifacts and logs." (Priya: ok?)
Priya (legal): OK on the snippet wording, but add link to the residency policy page for precise legal definitions.
Maya (docs): will link to /legal/data-residency. Also planning a tiny migration note: "If you have scripts setting REDWOOD_REGION, change to REGION_ALIAS or the explicit flag; deprecated env var will be removed Q3." Thoughts?
Jin (intl): fine, but mention that some older Dedicated clusters still honor REDWOOD_REGION for backwards compat. "Deprecated" warning acceptable.
Tom R (eng): one more tech caveat: while the CLI flag ensures region selection, routing can still be overridden by account-level routing policies; add that as a line so users know why they might still hit a different region.
Maya (docs): good catch, short sentence: "Account routing policies may override this flag; contact support if you require strict regional enforcement."
docs-bot: PR created by Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421 — includes snippet swap, alias table, and legal link.
Maya (docs): tagging reviewers: @Tom R, @Jin, @Priya for quick pass. I'll also mark this as a docs-only patch (no code change).
Tom R (eng): skimming now. small nit: change code block language to bash for highlighting.
Jin (intl): LGTM pending alias table entries accuracy. I'll drop a comment in the PR with exact mappings.
Priya (legal): approving the wording change; please ensure the legal link points to latest policy version.
Maya (docs): thanks all — I'll merge after approvals and then open a short customer-facing note for the change log.
Tom R (eng): thanks — and maybe add a one-line migration note in the SDK snippets too (some SDK examples still mention REDWOOD_REGION).
Maya (docs): good call, will sweep SDK snippets after merge.
Maya (docs): (after merge) merged and deployed; follow-up ticket to sweep SDK examples: DOCS-3172
Jin (intl): thanks, will help with translations for the EU locale pages.
docs-bot: changelog entry published: "CLI example: updated region flag and clarified residency option"
Maya (docs): closing thread — ping me if you spot anything else. :white_check_mark:
